why: An unmanifested model must not load. That is the whole point of this file: `render/models.js`
admits a model id only if it appears here, and refuses anything else with the reason, so a
character can never reach the screen without a recorded licence, scale, budget and consumer
list. The failure this prevents is the one the corpus already has: refs/MANIFEST.json records
`licence: null` on frames that are nonetheless on disk and cited.
Every entry MUST carry: source, licence, licence_url, real_world_scale_m, bounds_m, lods,
material_families, consumers, sha256 (null only for `procedural` sources, which have no file).

licence_policy.note: CC-BY-4.0 entries must carry an attribution string; the loader refuses one without.

base.saxhleel.note: Procedural for the reason recorded in orchestration/status/W1-30D-SOURCING-SPIKE.md. It is manifested anyway so the census and the admission path treat it exactly like a file-backed model, and so a later glTF replacement is a manifest edit rather than a code change.

consumers: render/renderer.js: DUMMY and human enemy archetypes
